en.title: The Centre Party's solution to the government question: "Constructive opposition"

Municipal commissioner Thomas Selin (C) in Huddinge proposes a broad centrist government or constructive opposition.

en.title: Muf leader's allies snubbed: "A protest vote against Alice"
en.summary: 23-year-old Alice Landerholm was recently elected new chair of the Moderate Youth League, Muf. There was no rival candidate, which TV4 Nyheterna had earlier revealed, and she was therefore elected unanimously.

en.title: Centre leader Effie Kourlos opens to a third way: "Can see yellow"
en.summary: Government to the left or right? Or become a constructive opposition party? Centre Party leader Effie Kourlos opens to the party letting through a bourgeois three-party government. – I think that has good chances of uniting the C, as a compromise.

sv.title: DN Debatt. ”Räcker inte att satsa på soldater – vi måste även stötta familjerna”
sv.summary: DN DEBATT. En lång militär karriär rymmer perioder av hög frånvaro från hemmet och krav på flexibilitet. Det riskerar att begränsa utrymmet i det egna yrkeslivet för kvinnor och män som lever tillsammans med officerare och soldater.

en.title: DN Debatt. ”It’s not enough to invest in soldiers – we must also support their families”
en.summary: DN DEBATT. A long military career includes periods of high absence from home and demands for flexibility. This risks limiting room in one’s own working life for women and men who live with officers and soldiers.

sv.title: Sensation om V skulle få ministrar
sv.summary: Ur ett historiskt perspektiv är C:s och S:s misstro mot Vänsterpartiet inte det minsta förvånande.

en.title: Sensation if the Left Party were to get ministers
en.summary: From a historical perspective, the Centre Party’s and the Social Democrats’ distrust of the Left Party is not the least bit surprising.

sv.title: Tomas Ramberg: Åkesson kan bli riksdagens kung

en.title: Tomas Ramberg: Åkesson could become king of the Riksdag
en.summary: On election night the Sweden Democrats appeared to be the big losers of the election. Now Jimmie Åkesson has the chance to turn defeat into success. If the Centre Party lets a Kristersson government through, Åkesson will become king of the Riksdag.

en.title: Here is the Moderates' full package to the Centre Party: "Had higher expectations"
en.summary: The Centre Party is now entering new government talks with the Moderates. SVT has obtained the Moderates' full package that forms the basis of the talks. – Frankly, I had higher expectations, says a Centre Party source.

sv.title: Upprörda känslor i C efter svängen: ”Ledsna och arga”

en.title: Strong feelings in the Centre Party after the U-turn: "Sad and angry"
en.summary: Late on Monday, Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist announced that the Centre Party is resuming talks with the centre-right parties. But the party is deeply split over the path forward, and many are very upset, Expressen learns. "People are sad, resigned, angry and feel powerless," says a Centre Party source.

en.title: Editorial: The Centre Party risks everything by moving to the right
en.summary: It may sound like a comfortable solution with a “bourgeois centre government”. But Ulf Kristersson's project has never been a centre cooperation – rather, it involves incorporating the SD into the right.

sv.summary: Riksdagen röstar på måndag om Ulf Kristersson som statsminister, det meddelar talman Andreas Norlén. Varken Kristersson eller Magdalena Andersson har presenterat ett färdigt regeringsunderlag utan det är istället Kristerssons avslutade sonderingsuppdrag som ligger bakom talmannens val.

en.summary: The Riksdag votes on Monday on Ulf Kristersson as prime minister, Speaker Andreas Norlén announced. en.title: Åkesson gloats – C and S are close to crash landing

sv.title: S vädjan till V – pekar på tonårsutvisningarna
sv.summary: Tonårsutvisningarna har enat de rödgröna partierna. Nu hoppas Socialdemokraterna att ungdomarnas vädjan kan få Vänsterpartiet att tänka om. – Det handlar om deras liv, då blir ministerposter väldigt litet i det, säger S-toppen Lawen Redar.

en.title: S appeal to V – points to teen deportations
en.summary: The teen deportations have united the red-green parties. Now the Social Democrats hope the young people's appeal can make the Left Party rethink. – It is about their lives, then ministerial posts matter very little in that, says S top figure Lawen Redar.

sv.title: Insändare. En minoritetsregering kan stärka Sveriges långsiktighet
sv.summary: INSÄNDARE. Stora samhällsfrågor inte alltid löses bäst av att ett block får makten att driva igenom sin politik på egen hand. En alliansregering i minoritet skulle sannolikt behöva söka stöd både till höger och vänster i riksdagen, skriver Leif Ekman.

en.title: Letter. A minority government can strengthen Sweden's long-term stability
en.summary: LETTER. Major societal issues are not always best solved by one bloc gaining the power to push through its policy on its own. An Alliance minority government would likely have to seek support both from the right and the left in the Riksdag, writes Leif Ekman.

sv.title: Tidigare V-toppen om samarbetet med S: ”Göran Persson hånade mig”
sv.summary: Vänsterpartiet har blivit erbjudna tjänstemän i regeringskansliet och statssekreterare men tydligt sagt nej. Tidigare mandatperioder som stödparti till S har gett känslan av att man blivit lurad. – Man kände sig som en gäst, en främling, säger Johan Lönnroth, före detta vice partiledare i V.

en.title: Former Left Party leader on cooperation with the Social Democrats: "Göran Persson mocked me"
en.summary: The Left Party has been offered civil service posts in the Government Offices and state secretary positions but clearly said no. Earlier terms as a support party to the Social Democrats have given the feeling of having been deceived. – One felt like a guest, a stranger, says Johan Lönnroth, former deputy party leader of the Left Party.

sv.title: C kan också göra som SD

en.title: C can also do as SD

sv.title: C-kommunalrådet varnar: ”Vi kommer gå samma öde till mötes som Liberalerna”
sv.summary: Förhandla med den rödgröna sidan. Om det inte går borde Centerpartiet förhandla om ett S-C-M-styre. Om det inte går borde Centerpartiet gå i opposition. Det säger Tomas Selin (C), kommunalråd i Huddinge.

en.title: C municipal commissioner warns: "We will face the same fate as the Liberals"
en.summary: Negotiate with the red-green side. If that fails, the Centre Party should negotiate an S-C-M administration. If that fails, the Centre Party should go into opposition. So says Tomas Selin (C), municipal commissioner in Huddinge.

sv.title: Ordkrig mellan S och V: ”Långlånglånglång rad förslag”
sv.summary: Efter över 70 dagar utan att regeringsfrågan är avgjord haglar anklagelserna på den rödgröna sidan om vems fel det är att förhandlingarna spruckit. ”Vänsterpartiet har inte kommit med ett enda konkret förslag”, säger Magdalena Andersson.

en.title: War of words between S and V: "Long, long list of proposals"
en.summary: After over 70 days without the government question being settled, accusations are flying on the red-green side over whose fault it is that the negotiations have broken down. "The Left Party has not put forward a single concrete proposal," says Magdalena Andersson.

sv.title: Utesluter inte SD-samarbete i intervju: ”Vet jag inte ännu”
sv.summary: I en SVT-intervju utesluter C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist inte ett samarbete med SD. – Det vet jag inte ännu. Vi fattar beslut inom partiet, säger hon. Kort efter intervjun hör C-ledaren av sig på nytt.

en.title: Does not rule out cooperation with SD in interview: "I don't know yet"
en.summary: In an SVT interview, Centre Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist does not rule out cooperation with the Sweden Democrats. "I don't know that yet. We make decisions within the party," she says. Shortly after the interview, the Centre Party leader gets back in touch again.

sv.title: Klart: Här är politikerna som ska styra Lund – och de som ska säga emot
sv.summary: Moderaterna tar över ordförandeklubban i nämnden som ansvarar för Lunds grundskolor och förskolor. M behåller också den ledande posten i skandalbolaget LKP – men Mats Helmfrid byts ut mot en partikamrat. Alla Lunds kommunala bolag ska ledas av män. Här är de som får tunga uppdrag i Lundapolitiken.

en.title: Confirmed: Here are the politicians who will run Lund – and those who will oppose them
en.summary: The Moderates take over the chair of the committee responsible for Lund's compulsory schools and preschools. M also keeps the leading post at the scandal-hit company LKP, but Mats Helmfrid is replaced by a party colleague. All of Lund's municipal companies are to be led by men. Here are those who get key assignments in Lund politics.

sv.title: Insändare. Nu bör Magdalena Anderssons ledarskap ifrågasättas
sv.summary: INSÄNDARE. Vi som röstade för förändring riskerar nu ytterligare fyra år med högerstyre. Om förhandlingarna med V, MP och C kollapsar bör Magdalena Andersson och de andra ansvariga i S-ledningen fråga sig om de fortfarande är rätt personer att leda partiet, skriver den tidigare S-riksdagsledamoten…

en.title: Letter. Now Magdalena Andersson's leadership should be questioned
en.summary: LETTER. We who voted for change risk another four years of right-wing rule. If negotiations with V, MP and C collapse, Magdalena Andersson and the others responsible in the S leadership should ask themselves whether they are still the right people to lead the party, writes the former S Riksdag member…

sv.title: S tappar – M snart ikapp
sv.summary: Moderaterna får sin högsta notering på åtta år i DN/Ipsos opinionsundersökning. Samtidigt fortsätter Socialdemokraterna att tappa – tillsammans med Centerpartiet. – Centerpartiet har satt sig i en väldigt svår sits, säger Nicklas Källebring vid Ipsos till DN.

en.title: S falling – M soon catching up
en.summary: The Moderates get their highest rating in eight years in the DN/Ipsos opinion poll. At the same time the Social Democrats continue to fall, together with the Centre Party. – The Centre Party has got itself into a very difficult situation, says Nicklas Källebring at Ipsos to DN.

sv.title: Rödgröna kraschen – S, C, MP och V skyller på varandra
sv.summary: De rödgröna förhandlingarna har kraschat. Nu skyller partierna på varandra. Vänsterpartiet ville inte förhandla, enligt S-ledaren Magdalena Andersson. – Hon visade kanske inte det ledarskap som behövs innan valet, svarar V-ledaren.

en.title: Red-green collapse – the Social Democrats, the Centre Party, the Green Party and the Left Party blame each other
en.summary: Negotiations among the red-greens have collapsed. Now the parties are blaming each other. The Left Party did not want to negotiate, according to S leader Magdalena Andersson. – She perhaps did not show the leadership needed before the election, responds the V leader.

sv.title: Bodströms attack mot Gabrielsson
sv.summary: Ida Gabrielsson har gjort mer för en ny Tidöregering än Jimmie Åkesson. Det anser tidigare S-ministern Thomas Bodström. ”Var politiken inte viktigare än så?” skriver han i sociala medier.

en.title: Bodström's attack on Gabrielsson
en.summary: Ida Gabrielsson has done more for a new Tidö government than Jimmie Åkesson. That is the view of former S minister Thomas Bodström. "Was politics not more important than that?" he writes on social media.

en.title: Two political scientists: Kristersson-led government looks likely

en.title: Here is the "starter package" for the Left Party – from the Social Democrats, the Centre Party and the Green Party

sv.title: S-budet till V – garantierna som ska få dem att vända

en.title: The S offer to the Left Party – the guarantees that are meant to make them turn
en.summary: The Social Democrats, the Centre Party and the Green Party are trying to lure the Left Party into dropping the government demand with a "starter package" containing reforms that the Left Party may "take credit for". Expressen has obtained it in full. "Ensures the Left Party's influence", the Social Democrats promise in the package.

sv.title: V: Ett mandat saknades – nu samlar vi stöd för ett rödgrönt styre 2030
sv.summary: Det finns en rad reformer som inte kommer att bli verklighet så länge Socialdemokraterna styr tillsammans med högerpartier. Vänsterpartiets huvudsakliga fokus kommer att vara att samla stöd för ett rödgrönt styre i Lunds kommun 2030. Det skriver V:s två ledande företrädare i Lund.

en.title: V: One seat was missing – now we are building support for a red-green government in 2030
en.summary: There are a number of reforms that will not become reality as long as the Social Democrats govern together with right-wing parties. The Left Party's main focus will be building support for a red-green government in Lund municipality in 2030. This is according to the Left Party's two leading representatives in Lund.
